metadata.tax_and_fee_methodology: Per NYC Local Law 2023/153 (NYC Council Finance Report), NYC hotel occupancy + combined sales/MCTD tax is 14.75% plus $3.50/night flat ($2.00 NYC unit fee + $1.50 NYS Javits fee = $24.50 per 7 nights). Mandatory hotel destination/resort fees ($0 to $45.91/night) are itemized separately so couples see true out-of-pocket 7-night totals.

cheapest_upcoming_dates_summary.why_cheapest: Sidesteps Valentine's Day (Sun Feb 14), Presidents' Day (Mon Feb 15), and NYC Public Schools Midwinter Recess (Feb 15–19, 2027), while staying inside February — before NYC hotel rates jump +28% to +57% in March 2027 (verified across Nov 2026 12-month rate tables).
cheapest_upcoming_dates_summary.even_cheaper_adjacent_promo: NYC Hotel Week 2027 runs Jan 2 – Feb 11, 2027 (25% off participating hotels, overlapping NYC Restaurant Week & Broadway Week Jan 19 – Feb 11, 2027) — ends 4 days before the user's Feb 15 window.
cheapest_upcoming_dates_summary.best_time_to_book: Book refundable 'Pay Later' base rate NOW (late Nov / Dec 2026, ~8–12 weeks ahead), then re-check & re-shop 21–35 days before arrival (late Jan / early Feb 2027) when NYC winter unsold inventory typically dips 10–18%.
